notes.title: Dev Diary 34| We keep it Gorgeous
notes.content:
Greetings, our beloved citizens. As you know, we're dedicated to preserving Golden Bay's natural beauty and integrity, and ongoing town maintenance efforts play a crucial role in this. Regular clean-up activities, conservation projects, and community involvement ensure that the area remains pristine for both locals and visitors. We're happy to inform you that some of the places are almost ready for you to explore!

[h2][b]A Serene Escape: Golden Bay Beach[/b][/h2]
Our proudly present town's jewel, the golden sands, and crystal-clear water, make it an ideal place to escape nature's embrace. You can also simply enjoy sunbathing, beach volleyball, or relaxing on the shore. A free shuttle bus service will be available at the shelter.

[h2][b]Treasure Hunting![/b][/h2]
To add an extra layer of fun, Golden Bay's city council is hosting an engaging Treasure Hunting Game designed for adventurers of all ages. Participants are invited to embark on a quest throughout the beach, searching for hidden treasures marked by unique clues and challenges. Uncover fascinating facts about the beach's history, natural wonders, and cultural significance. Get the cute souvenirs back home to remind you of all the good memories!

[h2][b]A Culinary Delight[/b][/h2]
Special support to celebrate your beach visit! The beachfront bar features quaint bars and eateries that serve homemade dishes crafted from fresh, locally sourced ingredients where you can savor delicious seafood and refreshed beverages. Now they're offering a 20% discount on every bill!

We understand that it's very hard to explore during maintenance time, so we want to offer you the refreshing experience of showcasing the beauty and authenticity of our town. With the community’s dedication to maintaining the area and the fun of the Treasure Hunting Game, there’s never been a better time to visit. 

[i]Kind regards,
Golden Bay City Council[/i]

notes.title: Dev Diary 13 | Weapon Elemental Upgrades
notes.content:
Since our mayor acquired a batch of special weapons, you must have noticed the mysterious weapon shop on the corner, right? Don't worry, it’s not an illegal store. This is a legitimate armory approved by the mayor, established to ensure that we can combat mutated monsters at any time.
This weapon shop continuously provides various weapons to every citizen living in Golden Bay. Its stable supply is one of the most basic guarantees for us to combat mutated monsters and other dangerous enemies.

Although the advanced technology weapons introduced by our weapon shop are undoubtedly an important force in maintaining law and order, as Golden Bay continues to prosper, the rampant monster attacks and threats from criminals are increasing. Relying on these weapons alone is far from enough! We need more advanced and sharper tactical equipment to ensure the long-term stability and security of Golden Bay !

Therefore, our weapon modification workshop, through relentless efforts, has developed a groundbreaking new technology – weapon elemental upgrades! This revolutionary upgrade is currently limited to the [Soil Rifle], but it is expected to gradually cover other types of weapons in the future.

[b]🔫Introduction to Weapon Elemental Upgrades[/b]
[list][*] Before starting the upgrade process on the weapon modification station, you need to prepare sufficient upgrade materials: adhesives, oil, screws, gears, and springs. Although these materials are hard to obtain, once you have them, your weapon will become exceptionally powerful.
[*] Golden Bay's weapon modification workshop has carefully prepared a variety of elemental upgrade options for you, each bringing different damage stacking effects! Options include standard chamber, energy chamber, freezing chamber, radiation chamber, flame chamber, electrical chamber, and virus chamber.
[*] Different elements will attach to enemies, bringing different shooting effects to your weapon. Choose the right element to upgrade your weapon, and you will be well-prepared when facing enemies. For example, the electrical element upgrade not only increases electrical damage by 50% but also enhances shooting rate and range. Below is an example of a weapon modified with the electrical element:[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827117/f336005284961e76edaeeb63048de898ae5d596f.jpg[/img]
[b]🎬Real-time Combat Footage[/b]

We have specially included a video showing the shooting effects of various elemental weapons. This video was filmed by front-line reporters from Golden Bay, who risked their lives to capture this footage. Please click to watch and understand how each elemental modification performs in real combat:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=71arZ5ebpOs

💪Combating mutated monsters and maintaining the safety of Golden Bay requires the collective efforts of every citizen. We hope this new service can provide more confident solutions when you face unknown threats, protecting our homeland.May every citizen live happily and safely through every moment!

notes.title: Dev Diary 12 | Tech Companion—Hyper2800 Smartphone
notes.content:
With the continuous advancement of technology, Golden Bay City Hall proudly presents the Hyper2800 mobile phone to enhance the convenience of its citizens' lives. This phone is not only portable and fully functional but also specially optimized to improve user experience, making your life smarter. 

✨[b]Below is a detailed introduction to the features of the Hyper2800 mobile phone[/b]

  [list]
[*]   [b]Map Navigation: [/b]The Hyper2800 is equipped with the latest map navigation system. No matter where you are, simply turn on this feature to get precise route guidance. With real-time traffic updates, walking navigation, and multiple travel mode options, your trips will be smooth and hassle-free.
[*]     [b]Vital Signs: [/b]This feature includes status analysis and load-bearing capacity, monitoring your basic health status in real-time, including heart rate, blood pressure, etc. Data is displayed in intuitive bar format, helping you stay informed about your physical condition at all times.
[*]     [b]Character Attributes: [/b]This feature covers strength, perception, endurance, intelligence, charisma, agility, and luck, helping you keep track of your physical fitness and personal state. For example, perception uses sensors and AI analysis to enhance your environmental sensitivity, ensuring you are promptly aware of changes around you; endurance affects your maximum health and resistance to illness; charisma influences the rewards you receive at work and transaction prices...
[*]    [b]Survival Skills: [/b]This section includes scavenging ability, repair level, driving proficiency, business capability, fire-starting skills, and swimming skills. Each skill records your proficiency and level in detail, aiming to provide guidance on survival skills, helping you thrive in Golden Harbor, and protecting yourself and friends in various dangerous situations.
[*]    [b]Lucy Personal Assistant:[/b] Life in Golden Bay doesn't have to be lonely. Lucy, as a personal assistant, can manage your schedule, remind you of important tasks, and tailor various activities and entertainment plans based on your personality and preferences.
[*]    [b]Settings:[/b] The Hyper2800 allows you to personalize settings based on your needs, including language, notification reminders, permission management, etc. The operation is simple, even those who are not tech-savvy can easily get started.
[*]    [b]Suicide:[/b] Life in Golden Bay is not always smooth, but unless absolutely necessary, do not click this. Using this feature will reset everything you have in Golden Harbor to zero, but fortunately, you can "restart your life."

notes.title: Dev Diary 11 | Team up, let's go!
notes.content:
Dear Citizens,

While Golden Bay attracts many explorers with its stunning natural scenery and tranquil environment, we are also aware that dangers lurking behind beauty constantly test our courage and wisdom. To enhance everyone’s exploration experience and better protect each citizen's safety, the researchers at Golden Bay City Hall have worked tirelessly and finally developed a new convenience system—the Team Function!

[b]✨Highlights of the Team Function[/b]
This brand-new system will bring you a safer and more convenient exploration experience. Here are some of the important features you will enjoy:
[list]
[*]  Map Location ：
  No matter where you are in Golden Bay, with the team function, you can easily find your teammates' real-time locations, ensuring that everyone stays in close contact, whether you are in lush forests or on steep hills.
[*]  Health Status Monitoring ：
 Understanding your teammates' health status is no longer a challenge. With this function, you can check your teammates' health values in real-time and provide timely support, significantly enhancing the team's survival chances when facing various wild monsters.
[*]  Cooperative Combat to Enhance Survival Chances ：
 During a monster swarm attack, the group function allows for more seamless battle arrangements. Team collaboration will be key to victory, and everyone can plan battle strategies together, effectively facing various challenges and protecting each other's survival.
[/list]
[b]🏝️Let's Embark on an Adventure Together![/b]
 
  Every inch of Golden Bay's beautiful and mysterious land hides countless surprises and adventures waiting to be discovered. In this ever-changing environment, the group function will provide citizens with stronger support and protection. Whether you are a daring explorer seeking thrills or someone who enjoys playing with friends, this new feature will add more joy to your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/5c0dca9acbc15670b69a9491951d07f19f92edf2.png[/img]

We sincerely hope every citizen will fully utilize this group function to move forward together and explore the endless charm of Golden Bay. Let us embrace challenges together, protect the home we love, and share more joy and friendship amid the enchanting scenery!

Wishing everyone an exciting and safe journey in Golden Bay!

notes.title: 🏷️Big Announcement for New World building Progress！
notes.content:

[h3]To provide a richer and more colorful gaming experience, we are actively preparing a new game map. Therefore, the frequency of game updates will be adjusted in the near future. At the same time, in order to facilitate this map transition, the buildings previously constructed by players will no longer be preserved. This change aims to provide everyone with a fresh start, allowing each player to freely explore, create, and adventure on the new map.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding of our game. We look forward to seeing the exciting stories and achievements you create on the new map! Please stay tuned for our latest announcements; we will announce the specific timeline for the map replacement at the appropriate time.  

Once again, thank you for your passionate support of our game! [/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary 4 | Weapon Shortage Alert
notes.content:
[h2]Dear residents of Golden Bay,
[/h2]

I believe many of you have noticed that the outbreak of monsters has become increasingly severe recently, and we are seeing more and more of these previously unknown creatures. Their bizarre forms and swift movements present a growing threat, and our arsenal, whether it be traditional AKs or modern laser guns, seems increasingly inadequate. Even worse, our conventional weapons are virtually ineffective against these peculiar newcomers— hold on, I'm not suggesting they are aliens, as I didn't mention "aliens" at all.

In these uncertain and fearful times, our beloved Mayor WTn (sorry, I promised not to disclose his full name) is taking proactive measures. Through his personal resources and networks, he plans to import a batch of special weapons from a city destroyed by war and radiation. Details about these weapons remain a mystery, and it is said that even the materials used are of an unprecedented, unknown alloy.
Hey, here are some blueprints and designs of these mysterious weapons that accidentally leaked from the mayor's office—just between us: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/80def60d17117e405e1ca06b75e6bade2f2ed969.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/0f2938e75e8b62018a5b390cd6b7670df748f125.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/cfbdcc55d062c5a3a75fd37b70720569ad65279c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/04e178fb1106a5a855145a57f2ec2a011435af0f.jpg[/img]

From these blueprints, it's clear that these new weapons are nothing like the ones we've used in the past. They boast complex mechanical structures and a cyberpunk aesthetic, seeming to blend traditional with futuristic technology. It certainly piques one's curiosity as to how much of an edge these weapons from afar might provide us.

The mayor has revealed that although the routes connecting us to the outside world have been severely damaged, it will take some time for these weapons to arrive—the transportation process is full of uncertainties. However, he assures us that no matter how long it takes, these new weapons will eventually safely reach Golden Bay, giving us a significant boost to counter this unprecedented onslaught of monsters.

Dear residents, even though the situation seems dangerous and helpless at the moment, there is no need to despair. New hope and assistance are on their way. Let's look forward to the day they arrive and prepare ourselves for it.

Join our community efforts to protect our homeland! Your involvement and vigilance are crucial as we unite to safeguard Golden Bay. Together, we can overcome these threats and ensure the safety and security of our beloved city.

Stay vigilant, stay strong—the future of Golden Bay is still bright.

notes.title: Dev Diary 1 | Guide to Survival and Prosperity
notes.content:
[h2][b]Introduction To The NEW Golden Bay
[/b]
[/h2]Greetings, residents of Golden Bay. In the wake of "The Incident", our community has faced massive disruption and change. The City Authority acknowledges the uncertainty many of us are experiencing during this time. To address this, we have prepared this essential guide so that each resident is well-informed and equipped to navigate the challenges and thrive amid the new normal:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/ee312c28f4806c0a48cbd89358692cac5d3d7b6d.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Resource Gathering[/b]
[/h2]To ensure a brighter future for Golden Bay, securing essential supplies is crucial. We encourage residents to contribute, whether by foraging natural resources or reclaiming lost assets. Just remember that looting and theft, while tempting, only harms our community. Choose your path wisely, as cooperation is key to our survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869025/884399e5445618c22eaea1e9542f0c2765f04576.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Build & Fortify[/b]
[/h2]The whole community is invited to take an active role in addressing the need for safe and stable housing. Select a vacant plot.
